preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 2000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 2000) representing the number of test cases.
Each of the t test cases consists of exactly three space-separated integers n, a, b.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(n) <= 2000 and 1 <= int(a) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(b) <= min(26, int(a)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n, a, b satisfy 1 ≤ a ≤ n ≤ 2000 and 1 ≤ b ≤ min(26, a).
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line) == int(n) for output_line, (n, a, b) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [(int(x) for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string has length exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.islower() and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in output_line) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output string consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(output_line[i:i+a])) == int(b) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() for i in range(len(output_line) - int(a) + 1))
postconditions.description: For each test case, every substring of length a in the output string has exactly b distinct letters.
